title: Student Assistant, User Research & Human Factors Engineering
description_md:
Do you want to gather hands-on work experience from an international MedTech company?

You will focus on supporting the team in their everyday tasks as well as set up for user studies and support with data analysis. In addition, you will be managing our local ‘Innovation Space’ to ensure it is kept up to date and inspire the local team to be creative.
